description: Export a whole course, wait for Canvas to package it, then download the .imscc archive to local disk. Nothing in the course changes. Can take several minutes; use it before a term ends and access disappears. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

dest_dir.description: Folder to save into: the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR) or a folder inside it, such as "week1". Anywhere else is refused. Leave it out to use the download folder itself.

name: export_course_archive
title: Export Course Archive
